response.overview: Ula wants to see her deceased son. Together with Dorothy, his girlfriend, she deceives the receptionist to get into the morgue after hours. Their plan falls apart when Julia, a morgue employee, catches Ula standing over the body of her late son. Ula explains that her son can still become a father with a simple procedure. Julia hesitates, but helps, confessing she lost her own son, who was killed in Donetsk. Does the deceased’s body still belong to him, or to those who love him?
response.tagline: Ula lies to the hospital staff to get into the mortuary and see her dead son, but what she plans goes beyond a simple visit.
response.title: Visiting Time
